name: Miranda Dulce Tostadora
source:
Miranda is a star - a celebrity in her own right. She's the lead singer with her own band The Migas. She's very loving and warm, unless you cross her, then she can leave you burned. It's not recommended to play with her emotions because she knows she deserves better and can dish a heated serving of sass right back. She adores an audience and loves to make a crowd happy (or sad) with her sweet melodies. Ultimately, she wants someone who loves her as much as she loves to sing (which might not be possible.)
Likes: Slow Burns 
Dislikes: Cooking

[From the in-game Date-a-dex]
